libraries.name: PhysicalProperties

members.name: new
members.note: The Material form uses this engine's table of the common materials; other materials get Plastic's values.
members.doc: From a Material, or from density, friction, elasticity and optional friction weight, elasticity weight and acoustic absorption (weights default to 1).

value_members.name: Density
value_members.doc: Mass per cubic stud.

value_members.name: Friction
value_members.doc: Friction coefficient.

value_members.name: Elasticity
value_members.doc: Bounciness, 0 to 1.

value_members.name: FrictionWeight
value_members.doc: How much this part's friction counts when two parts touch.

value_members.name: ElasticityWeight
value_members.doc: How much this part's elasticity counts when two parts touch.

value_members.name: AcousticAbsorption
value_members.doc: How much sound the material absorbs, 0 to 1.

libraries.doc: The physical material of a part: density, friction and elasticity with their weights.

members.name: new
members.doc: The default filter: exclude nothing, Default collision group.

value_members.name: FilterDescendantsInstances
value_members.doc: The instances (with their descendants) to exclude or include; reading returns a new array.

value_members.name: FilterType
value_members.doc: Exclude (the default) or Include.

value_members.name: CollisionGroup
value_members.doc: Only parts that collide with this group are tested; "Default" by default.

value_members.name: RespectCanCollide
value_members.doc: True to skip parts whose CanCollide is false.

value_members.name: BruteForceAllSlow
value_members.doc: True to test every part, skipping the broad phase.

value_members.name: AddToFilter
value_members.doc: Appends an instance or an array of instances to the filter.

value_members.name: IgnoreWater
value_members.doc: True to pass through terrain water.

libraries.doc: The filter of a ray or shape cast. The workspace queries read it.
